verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of workspace or board item caps, or of performance with tens of thousands of tasks. The "scaling" mention in docs-16 covers app-hosting infrastructure, not board or workspace scale. Community reports describe the interface as slow, but they give no item limits or large-workspace benchmarks, so nothing shows the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
